rationale: browserUrl starts from the fixed current origin and assigns pathname/search via URL setters. A path with leading double slash is serialized as an absolute same-origin URL; ordinary paths retain relative hrefs. URL parsing can no longer reinterpret pathname text as an authority. Existing fragment behavior and navigation callbacks remain unchanged. Regression tests cover double/triple slash, target=_blank anchor origin, and normal-click history updates.
